Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared that Israel is "at war," stating the nation faces a serious military engagement rather than a limited operation. Hamas launched coordinated rocket attacks from Gaza early Saturday morning, prompting the Israeli government to declare a state of war readiness.

Netanyahu issued orders for Israeli forces to eliminate terrorists who had infiltrated Israeli territory and authorized large-scale mobilization of military reserves. He warned that "the enemy will pay an unprecedented price."

Defense Minister Yoav Galant approved the reserve force mobilization following the intense barrage of rockets fired from multiple Gaza locations. Israel's Iron Dome defense system successfully intercepted numerous projectiles.

According to Israeli media reports, the attacks resulted in at least 20 Israeli deaths and over 540 injuries.
